01 · The problem
Running AI where your data lives
Why some AI stays in-house, and why that is hard to build.
Control
Your models learn from your proprietary data. In-house, you decide who touches it and where it lives.
Compliance
Security and sovereignty rules can dictate where data is allowed to live. Some workloads simply can't leave.
Cost at steady use
For GPUs that run all day, every day, predictable cost becomes a big part of the decision.
But an AI cluster isn't a bigger data center.
GPUs talk to each other nonstop, racks need far more power and cooling, and the network is a new kind of fabric. Most teams have never built one.
